top_signals.title: UOB Shares Tumble as Profit Misses Analysts’ Expectations
top_signals.summary: United Overseas Bank Ltd. reported third-quarter profit that missed expectations, as a decline in trading and investment income combined with narrowing interest margin crimped gains from lending and fees. Shares fell.
